utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How much of the repair drive is left?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Not much — maybe a third left. I’ve seen a few more folks drop by, so it’s moving.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, so it sounds like we might finish today. Do you need anything else from me?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Noah. I’ve got some tools I can lend for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus. I might need to borrow those tools if I can find the right project.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely, just let me know which project you have in mind and I’ll help you get the right tools.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive is picking up steam now — folks are dropping off tools and a bit of cash by the hour. I heard the block captain wants to wrap it up by Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s good to hear. I’ll tell Pia the Sunday deadline is still the target.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive, Opal. Tell me what needs doing and I’ll pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Happy to start. I’ve got a few spots on the repair drive that need checking, and I’ll point you to the ones that still need work.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, point me to the spots and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m heading over to the repair drive after lunch, and you should come by too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, but I can’t make it this time.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Ah, come by if you change your mind, we’ll be there after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Leo. I’ve got the repair drive organized, and I can keep track of the sign-ups and supplies from here.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, thanks, Rosa. I’ll handle the repairs and keep you posted if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Can you tell me exactly what needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah — the front gate latch and the hall light switch are both acting up, and I can point out the rest when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it, I’ll check those two first and wait for you to point out the rest when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with that, but I need to know when the drive is happening so I can work it around school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It’s next Saturday morning, right after the school drop-off rush. I’ll send you the exact time once I confirm the venue.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, send me the exact time when you have it and I’ll make sure it works with pickup.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard a little about the repair drive, but I'm still catching up. What did Jules say about it?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: She said it’s a neighborhood repair drive and that folks are pitching in to fix little things for anyone who needs help. I can fill you in on the details if you want.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, yeah, I’d like that. What kinds of things are they fixing?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I can help with that. What do you need fixed?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: What exactly do you need fixed?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Just the essentials: a leaky faucet and the garage door.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can help with that repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, I’ll bring the tools over tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good, I’ll be ready when you bring them over.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can help with the repair drive. Tell me what needs fixing and I’ll keep it moving.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got the list. I’ll check what’s missing and keep the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll keep the repair drive moving too. Tell me what’s missing and I’ll stay on it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive’s moving along. Need any help dropping things off?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I could use a hand. Anything you can drop off helps.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing, I can swing by with whatever needs dropping off.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hey Vik, I may be a bit fuzzy, but I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll bring the tools and a few extra gloves; I’ll repeat the plan at the drive so everyone’s on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, I’ll help however I can—just point me to whatever needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive. I think I saw something about that earlier, but I missed the details.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I think it’s the repair drive this Saturday at the community hall. I can forward the details if you want.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, please do. I might miss it again otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can lend a hand with that drive, Eli. What do you need fixed first?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: The battery. Then the belt if there’s time.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll start with the battery, then check the belt if we’ve got time.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with that, Quinn. Tell me what still needs fixing and I’ll see what I can do.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Mara. I’ve got a few odds and ends on the list, and I’ll send the details over right away.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, send them over and I’ll take a look as soon as they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, I can help with that repair drive. I know a few folks who’d be glad to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, then let’s keep it local—I can point them to the folks on Cedar and Maple who’ve helped with repairs before.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, that sounds like a solid local network to lean on. I’ll keep it with the Cedar and Maple folks and see who can lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve got the signup list ready, and I’ll keep the repair drive organized. Just let me know what you need from me next.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, Rosa. I’ll bring the supplies list and tell you if anything else is needed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, I’ll keep everything moving and let you know if I need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there’s a repair drive happening, but I’m still catching up on the details. Is there anything I should bring?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Just water is fine, and if you have any old towels or spare parts, bring those too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — I’ll bring water and see if I can find any old towels or spare parts too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with that.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely, I can make time for that after school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, I’ll bring the tools list and a quick breakdown of what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with that—what still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: What exactly still needs fixing on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Mostly the small fixes: a few loose boards, a bit of paint touch-up, and the front step needs tightening.
